levels.title: Kindle Hollow
levels.subtitle: Light the Hollow
levels.description: The original valley: five programming quests, a village to explore and a world to build.

levels.title: Village Morning
levels.subtitle: A first day at home
levels.description: Wake at home with Hotaru, your fairy guide. Say hello and connect your movement keys with blocks or Python, then follow the lane to the giant Rootward tree and the town hall.

levels.title: Sparks & Machines
levels.subtitle: An apprentice's year
levels.description: Move into the old workshop above Haverlund, wake Hotaru, and give the town's quiet machines their jobs back.

character.caption: Lodger in Nell's loft
character.blurb: You've come to Haverlund to learn a trade. Nell's workshop is below you; her old robot sleeps on the shelf.
